summary: The Radiant Wings Summon banner featuring exclusive Legendary hero Anneliesis, Lord of Judgment, returns from November 8 to November 22. Completing 300 summons during this event guarantees obtaining Anneliesis. She functions as a cornerstone hero for Aura teams, providing defensive shields while boosting ally offense for improved overall damage and team survivability.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Shields allies, boosts offensive performance, and increases both team damage and survival.
